note: Drop Zone games (D-074). Range ball (GolfBallRules): launch speed = club speed x power^power_curve at the club's loft, quadratic drag, backspin lift (decays at spin_decay/s) -> full-power carry ~200 m driver / 140 m 7-iron / 90 m wedge; first bounce keeps bounce of the vertical and roll_keep of the horizontal speed, then it rolls out at roll_friction m/s2. Targets score where the ball first lands (inner bullseye_frac of the radius x bullseye_mult). Putting: speed = power x max_speed, slowing at decel_green / decel_fringe / decel_sand m/s2; drops into the cup when within cup_r below cup_max_speed; water = +1 stroke, back to the last spot. Pickleball (PickleballRules): rally scoring to win_points (win by win_by), CPU opponent.
